verdict.rationale: Codex is itself an AI coding agent, and delegation is its core function. The docs describe delegating longer tasks to run in parallel in isolated cloud environments, starting them from the web, CLI, GitHub, Linear or Slack, then reviewing the diff, requesting follow-ups or opening a PR; locally it edits files, runs commands and hands focused work to subagents. Hands-on users corroborate this (one likens it to having L3-L4 engineers at your disposal). Mixed reports on model quality are opinions, not a concrete failure of the capability. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence of reliable task execution, since some users say it struggles or is weak at orchestrating subagents.
